value: Jaina recognizes the locket she once gave Arthas. He kept it through the years of ruin and the fall of their kingdom. Tears come before words; then she holds to a small hope that some part of him might remember who he was before Frostmourne. Her words do not undo what he became. They name the distance between the young prince she loved and the Lich King she helped confront.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
